run_trainer_train: run the MaskFormer video training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
run_trainer_eval: run the MaskFormer video model evaluation only mode using a config file and pre-trained weights
build_trainer_optimizer: build an AdamW or SGD optimizer with gradient clipping and per-layer learning rate for the model
build_trainer_train_loader: build a YTVIS training data loader with dataset mapper and detection dataset dicts
test_trainer_model: test the MaskFormer video model on a dataset and print evaluation results in CSV format
